lightsheetZarrLevel.name: label
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Human-readable name for this level (e.g. 'mean level 2 (12.8um)'). Empty allowed.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: level
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: 0-based level index within the parent pyramid. 0 is the finest resolution.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: reduction
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: The reduction of this level relative to level 0 ('mean', 'max', ...). Redundant with the parent's field but stored here so a level can be interpreted without loading the parent.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: axes_order
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Copied from the parent pyramid; carried here for self-describing reads.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: shape
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Per-axis size of this level's array, in axes_order.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: chunks
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Per-axis chunk size, in axes_order. This is the NGFF / Zarr chunk shape.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: chunk_grid
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Per-axis count of chunks along each axis = ceil(shape ./ chunks).

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: n_chunks_stored
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Number of chunk.bin_# files that were written. May be less than prod(chunk_grid) when trailing empty (fill-value) chunks were elided.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: chunk_index_origin
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: The first # in the chunk.bin_# series. Always 1 by convention (NDI file series are 1-based).

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: chunk_order
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: The order in which the chunk grid is flattened to the 1-based file series. 'C' for C-order (last axis fastest); 'F' for Fortran-order.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: fill_value
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Fill value for chunks that were elided from the file series.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: byte_order
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Byte order of the on-disk chunk bytes: 'little' or 'big'.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: codec
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Zarr codec name ('raw', 'blosc', 'zstd'). 'raw' means the chunk file is the plain little-endian array bytes in dtype / chunk_order.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: codec_params
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: JSON-encoded string of the codec parameters (cname, clevel, shuffle, ...). Empty JSON '{}' for 'raw'.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: voxel_size
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: Per-axis voxel size at this level, in voxel_size_units.

lightsheetZarrLevel.name: voxel_size_units
lightsheetZarrLevel.documentation: The unit that voxel_size is expressed in.
